sections.title: 一、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话,完成第1、2小题。

audio.text:
Boy: Do you know Liu Boshu? He is a great painter.
Girl: Yes, I know him. He was Xu Beihong's student.
Boy: Right. Both of them are good at drawing horses.
Girl: I think Xu Beihong's horses look strong and powerful.
Boy: Yes. And Liu Boshu's horse paintings are more lively and natural.
Girl: They have different styles, but both are wonderful.

questions.translation: 哪一项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'They have different styles, but both are wonderful.' 可知两位画家的画风不同但都很棒，并没有说徐悲鸿的画更好，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Which one is NOT true?
options: Liu Boshu's paintings are lively and natural.
The two painters' styles (风格) are different.

questions.translation: 他们主要在谈论什么？
questions.explanation: 对话围绕徐悲鸿和刘勃舒两位画家画马的作品及风格展开，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What are they mainly talking about?

sections.title: 二、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话,完成第3、4、5小题。

audio.text:
Reporter: Hi, Doctor Li! Do apples help us stay healthy? Some people say they have much sugar and hurt teeth.
Doctor Li: Well, not really. Apples have a little sugar, and they can clean our teeth well.
Reporter: Many people eat apples with peel. Is that good?
Doctor Li: It's OK! Wash it carefully before you eat it. The peel has more nutrients than the inside part. It is much healthier to eat with peel.
Reporter: Can we eat two apples a day? Will we get fat?
Doctor Li: Don't worry. One or two apples a day are fine.

questions.translation: 医生对苹果有什么看法？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Apples have a little sugar, and they can clean our teeth well.' 可知苹果含少量糖分，能帮助清洁牙齿，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What does the doctor think of apples?
options: Apples are bad for teeth because of too much sugar.
Apples have a little sugar and they can help clean our teeth.
Apples have no sugar and are always good for teeth.

questions.translation: 关于苹果皮医生说了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'The peel has more nutrients than the inside part.' 可知苹果皮比果肉含有更多营养，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What does the doctor say about apple peel?

questions.translation: 这段对话的主要内容是什么？
questions.explanation: 整段对话围绕记者向李医生咨询关于吃苹果的健康建议展开，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of this dialogue?

sections.title: 三、句子归类
sections.instruction: 读句子,将下列句子进行归类 (Fact / Opinion)。

questions.prompt: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west every day.
questions.translation: 太阳每天东升西落。
questions.explanation: 这是客观存在的自然规律与科学事实，属于 Fact。

questions.prompt: I think reading books is more meaningful than watching a film.
questions.translation: 我认为读书比看电影更有意义。
questions.explanation: 句中包含 'I think'，表达个人主观感受与看法，属于 Opinion。

questions.prompt: We go to school from Monday to Friday every week.
questions.translation: 我们每周周一至周五去上学。
questions.explanation: 这是客观陈述的日常生活事实，属于 Fact。

questions.prompt: I feel that playing basketball is more exciting than playing football.
questions.translation: 我觉得打篮球比踢足球更令人兴奋。
questions.explanation: 句中包含 'I feel that'，表达个人主观喜好与观点，属于 Opinion。

questions.prompt: In my view (观点), morning exercise is better than evening exercise.
questions.translation: 依我之见，晨练比晚练更好。
questions.explanation: 句首使用 'In my view' 明确表明个人观点，属于 Opinion。

questions.prompt: Summer is hotter than spring in most parts of China.
questions.translation: 在中国大部分地区夏天比春天热。
questions.explanation: 这是客观的气候地理事实，属于 Fact。

sections.title: 四、听力判断 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容判断句子是否与所听到的内容一致,一致的在括号中用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

audio.text:
Dear crayons,
I read your letters and felt sorry I didn't use you well. Grey, you can draw small things too. Pink, I'll draw a pink dinosaur for you. Black, you'll do more than just draw lines. I'll use you to draw a rainbow and rocks. White, I'll use you on top of other colours to show you more. Green, don't worry. Yellow and Orange will take turns colouring the sun.
All of you are special. No colour is better than the others. Let's draw nice pictures together. I'm looking forward to drawing great works with you!
Love,
Duncan

questions.translation: 邓肯读了蜡笔们的信，感到很生气。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'I read your letters and felt sorry'，他是感到抱歉/遗憾，而不是生气，故为 F。
questions.prompt: Duncan read the crayons' letters and felt angry.

questions.translation: 灰色蜡笔将被用来画更多的大型动物。
questions.explanation: 听力原文提到 'Grey, you can draw small things too'（灰色你也可以画小东西），故为 F。
questions.prompt: Grey will be used to draw more big animals.

questions.translation: 邓肯会用粉色蜡笔画一只恐龙。
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确提到 'Pink, I'll draw a pink dinosaur for you'，与题干一致，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Duncan will draw a dinosaur with Pink.

questions.translation: 黑色蜡笔以后将完全不画线条。
questions.explanation: 听力原文为 'Black, you'll do more than just draw lines. I'll use you to draw a rainbow and rocks.'，指不止用来画线，而不是完全不画线，故为 F。
questions.prompt: Black will not draw lines at all later.

questions.translation: 邓肯将以更好的方式使用所有的蜡笔。
questions.explanation: 信中邓肯为每支蜡笔都安排了合适美好的用途，并期待一起创作出好作品，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Duncan will use all his crayons in a better way.

sections.title: 五、对话填空 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 读对话,选择最佳选项,将对话补充完整,将其标号填写在横线上。

dialogue.speaker: Red Crayon
dialogue.text: I think I am the best crayon of all. [1]

dialogue.speaker: Pink Crayon
dialogue.text: [2] Because I look sweet and pretty, and lots of children like me very much.

dialogue.speaker: Black Crayon
dialogue.text: Don't always say you are the best. [3] People can't make nice pictures without me.

dialogue.speaker: White Crayon
dialogue.text: I agree with Black. And I can make all colours look clean and nice in a painting.

dialogue.speaker: Red Crayon
dialogue.text: You are all right. [4] Every crayon has its own special use.

wordbank: Because my colour can make pictures warm and lively.
But I think I am great too.
I help draw all the lines in every picture.
No one can make a good picture by itself.
Let's get on well and draw beautiful pictures together.

questions.translation: 因为我的颜色能让画作温暖而生动。
questions.explanation: 红色蜡笔认为自己是最好的，紧接着给出原因 'Because my colour can make pictures warm and lively.'，故选 B。
questions.answer: Because my colour can make pictures warm and lively.

questions.translation: 但我觉得我也很棒。
questions.explanation: 粉色蜡笔表达不同意见，说明自己也很棒并给出原因，故选 A。
questions.answer: But I think I am great too.

questions.translation: 我帮忙在每幅画中画所有的线条。
questions.explanation: 黑色蜡笔强调自己的功能是画线，后文提到没有我人们画不出好看的画，故选 C。
questions.answer: I help draw all the lines in every picture.

questions.translation: 没有哪支蜡笔能独自完成一幅好画。
questions.explanation: 红色蜡笔认同大家的看法，指出每支蜡笔都有特别用处，没有任何一个能单独完成，故选 D。
questions.answer: No one can make a good picture by itself.

questions.translation: 让我们好好相处，一起画出美丽的画卷吧。
questions.explanation: 所有蜡笔达成一致，号召大家和睦相处共同画画，故选 E。
questions.answer: Let's get on well and draw beautiful pictures together.

options: Because my colour can make pictures warm and lively.
But I think I am great too.
I help draw all the lines in every picture.
No one can make a good picture by itself.
Let's get on well and draw beautiful pictures together.

sections.title: 六、听力填空 (Fuel up)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容补全信息。

audio.text: This is Penny, P-E-N-N-Y, Penny. She is an 11-year-old girl. She felt nervous before the school show. She told the reason to her teacher. Penny's dress was grey. She thought it was worse than the other girls'. The teacher told her to believe in herself. She tried her best to dance. Finally, she danced well and got warm cheers. Her story tells us: Don't worry. Just enjoy what you do.

sections.passage:
# A Wonderful Show
* **Name:** [1]
* **Age:** [2]
* **What happened:**
  - felt nervous and told the [3] to her teacher
  - thought her dress was [4] and worse [5] other girls'
  - tried her best, danced well and got warm cheers
* **What we learned:** Don't worry and enjoy what we do.

questions.translation: 名字：Penny
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确拼写为 Penny（P-E-N-N-Y）。
questions.prompt: Name

questions.translation: 年龄：11岁
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'She is an 11-year-old girl.'，年龄填 11 或 eleven。
questions.prompt: Age

questions.translation: 原因：reason
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'She told the reason to her teacher.'，故填 reason。
questions.prompt: told the _____ to her teacher

questions.translation: 灰色：grey
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'Penny's dress was grey.'，故填 grey。
questions.prompt: thought her dress was _____

questions.translation: 比：than
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'She thought it was worse than the other girls'.'，比较级搭配 than。
questions.prompt: and worse _____ other girls'

sections.title: 七、完形填空 (Fuel up)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容,选择恰当的单词,将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: Last week, Tom made a mistake in his class project. He felt upset and didn't want others to [1] it. His friend came to talk with him and pointed out his problem gently. Tom listened carefully and [2] the opinion. He [3] his best to correct his mistake. Soon his work became much better. We all may do wrong things. Don't be shy or angry. Take others' [4] ideas. Learning from them will make us [5].

questions.translation: 他感到难过，不想让其他人知道这件事。
questions.explanation: 短语 want sb. to do sth. 中 to 为不定式符号，后接动词原形 know，故选 A。

questions.translation: Tom认真倾听并接受了意见。
questions.explanation: take the opinion 意为“采纳/接受意见”，讲述过去的事情用过去式 took，故选 B。

questions.translation: 他尽全力改正错误。
questions.explanation: 短文整体为一般过去时，动词用过去式 tried，故选 A。

questions.translation: 听取他人善意的想法。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，朋友温和指正属于善意的想法（kind ideas），故选 A。

questions.translation: 向他们学习会使我们变得更好。
questions.explanation: 向他人学习能够让我们进步、变得更好（better），故选 B。

sections.title: 八、任务型阅读 (鱼骨图)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容填写恰当的词,完成下方的鱼骨图。(每空一词)
sections.passage:
# Why We Don't Need to Give Up All Plastic Bags

Some people think we should ban (禁止) all plastic bags, but I disagree with this idea. We don't need to give up all plastic bags. Here are the two reasons.

Firstly, plastic bags are light and convenient (方便的) in daily life. They are easy to take when we go shopping. Besides, they can be folded (折叠) and put into our bags or pockets with us.

Secondly, plastic bags are useful and reusable. They can keep food away from dirt (灰尘) better. What's more, they can be kept to use many times. This helps protect our environment.

In fact, plastic bags are not bad if we use them in a right way. We should reduce waste and recycle them, instead of giving up all plastic bags completely (完全地).

---

### Arguments Summary
* **Reason 1:** Plastic bags are [1] and convenient in daily life.
  * (1) They are [2] to take.
  * (2) They can be [3] into our bags or pockets.
* **Main Idea:** We don't need to give up all plastic bags.
* **Reason 2:** Plastic bags are useful and reusable.
  * (1) They can keep food away from dirt [4].
  * (2) They can be used [5] times.

questions.translation: 轻便的：light
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段第一句 'Firstly, plastic bags are light and convenient in daily life.' 可知填 light。
questions.prompt: Plastic bags are _____ and convenient

questions.translation: 容易的：easy
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段第二句 'They are easy to take when we go shopping.' 可知填 easy。
questions.prompt: They are _____ to take.

questions.translation: 放入：put / folded
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段 'they can be folded and put into our bags or pockets'，题干已写 into，填 put (或 folded)，参考答案为 put。
questions.prompt: They can be _____ into our bags or pockets.

questions.translation: 更好地：better
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段 'They can keep food away from dirt better.' 可知填 better。
questions.prompt: keep food away from dirt _____.

questions.translation: 许多：many
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段 'they can be kept to use many times.' 可知填 many。
questions.prompt: can be used _____ times.

sections.title: 九、阅读理解 (Wise Words by the River)
sections.instruction: 阅读文章,根据文章内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Wise Words by the River

Zhuangzi and Huizi were two famous wise men in ancient China. One day, they walked by the Hao River (濠水) and watched fish swimming in the water.

Zhuangzi said the fish looked very happy. Huizi did not agree with him. He said Zhuangzi was not a fish, so he could not know the fish's true feeling. The fact is that no one can truly understand the thoughts of other living things (生物). Zhuangzi answered him cleverly. He asked Huizi how he could know what he was thinking, since (既然) Huizi was not him. After saying this, they smiled at each other.

Their talk became a well-known debate in history. From the story, we can not only tell fact from opinion, but also learn to respect (尊重) different ideas.

questions.translation: 庄子和惠子这天在哪里散步？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第一段 'One day, they walked by the Hao River and watched fish swimming in the water.' 可知是在濠水河边，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Where did Zhuangzi and Huizi walk on this day?

questions.translation: 庄子对水里的鱼说了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段 'Zhuangzi said the fish looked very happy.' 可知庄子说鱼看起来很快乐，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What did Zhuangzi say about the fish?
options: The fish could not swim well.
The fish were afraid of people.

questions.translation: 惠子为什么不同意庄子的看法？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段 'He said Zhuangzi was not a fish, so he could not know the fish's true feeling.' 可知因为没有人能真正知晓非自身的感受，故选 B。
questions.prompt: Why didn't Huizi agree with Zhuangzi?
options: Because no one could really know the fish's feeling.
Because he wanted to leave right away.

questions.translation: 关于他们的谈话我们能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段 'Their talk became a well-known debate in history.' 可知这场谈话成为历史上著名的辩论，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What do we know about their talk?
options: It is a famous debate in history.

questions.translation: 从这个故事中我们能学到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章结尾 'From the story, we can not only tell fact from opinion, but also learn to respect different ideas.' 可知我们要学会尊重不同的观点，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What can we learn from the story?
options: We must always agree with others.
We can know all animals' thoughts.
